name: Command
intent: A search field over a grouped list of pages, records and actions. Typing filters the list; arrow keys and Enter pick.
usage: Use Command for quick jumps and actions across the app, like a global search. It is one component: pass groups of items as data. Typing filters by label and description, and the typed text shows bold in each label. Arrow keys move the highlight and Enter picks; Escape clears the search. It shows inline; a ⌘K palette comes later. variant tabs turns the group headings into tabs (All, Records, Reports...), like the global search. scopes adds a menu in the search row to narrow what it looks through. onViewAll adds a View all results row at the end. AppHeader and Toolbar open it over their search field, so the field grows into the results. See contracts/command.json for the full contract.

itemShape.heading: string?
itemShape.items: CommandItem[]: { id: string, label: string, description?: string, icon?: string, shortcut?: string, disabled?: boolean }

groups.note: Groups are split by a thin line. icon is a Material Symbols name. shortcut shows as a key, like N. Icons sit in a tinted tile, like DropdownMenu.

variant.note: list shows every group with its heading. tabs adds a kit Tabs strip under the search: All, then one tab per group heading, like Records / Reports / Sections. A heading tab shows only that group; with a query each tab shows its result count.

iconStyle.note: tile puts each item icon in a tinted 32px tile. plain shows just the icon, in neutral, darker on the highlighted row.

size.note: md: the 44px search row. sm: a 28px row with no clear button (Escape clears), to lay over a small field like the Toolbar search.

label.note: Name of the search field and the list for screen readers.

placeholder.default: Search by name, type, and more...

empty.default: No matches found for this search.

defaultQuery.note: Start with a search already typed.

hints.note: Footer with the arrow keys to browse and Enter to select.

scopes.note: Adds a scope menu at the end of the search row, like Products / Accounts. A kit DropdownMenu.

defaultScope.note: Uncontrolled start scope. Defaults to the first scope.

onScopeChange.note: (scope: string) => void. Focus returns to the search field.

autoFocus.note: Focus the search field on mount, when Command opens from a trigger like the AppHeader search.

onSelect.note: (id: string) => void. Runs on Enter or click.

onViewAll.note: (query: string) => void. With a query, adds a last row, View all results for <query>, in link blue. Arrow keys reach it; Enter or click runs it.

useWhen: A global search across pages, records and reports.
A quick list of actions people find by typing.
doNot: Do not invent CommandInput, CommandList, CommandItem, CommandGroup, CommandEmpty, CommandDialog or SearchPanel.
Do not use for a short list of actions from a button. Use DropdownMenu.
Do not use for choosing a form value. Use RadioGroup, or Select when it exists.
Do not wrap it in a local overlay or build a ⌘K palette yet.
a11y: The search field is a combobox with aria-controls, aria-autocomplete=list and aria-activedescendant pointing at the highlighted option.
The list is a listbox; groups are labelled by their heading; items are options with aria-selected and aria-disabled.

Focus stays in the search field. Nothing is highlighted until the pointer is over a row or the arrow keys move (Down starts at the first result, Up at the last); leaving the list clears it. Enter picks the highlighted result, or the first one. Escape clears the search.
A polite status message says how many results match.
The key hints footer is hidden from screen readers; icons are decorative.
